name: io.github.zactonz/zactonz-mcp
title: Zactonz
description: Screenshots, page to Markdown, link previews, DNS, SSL, WHOIS, QR codes and more for AI agents.

environmentVariables.name: ZACTONZ_API_KEYS
environmentVariables.description: One or more Zactonz API keys, separated by commas. Create them at https://developers.zactonz.com/console/

environmentVariables.name: ZACTONZ_MCP_INLINE_IMAGE_BYTES
environmentVariables.description: Largest image, in bytes, returned inline with a tool result. Default 750000. Set 0 to return links only.
